context: Third signal family per the original research plan. Different mechanism from momentum/reversal: this is a level-based (supply/demand at resistance) signal, not a pure return-ranking signal. A stock making a new intermediate-term high on above-average volume is hypothesized to reflect genuine institutional accumulation clearing a resistance level, distinct from momentum's continuation-of-past-returns story and from short-horizon reversal's overreaction-correction story.
signal_definition: At each Friday close: pct_to_high = close_t / max(close[t-126 .. t-1]) - 1 (positive means today is a new 126-trading-day, ~6 month, high). Volume confirmation: vol_ratio = mean(volume[t-4..t]) / mean(volume[t-62..t]) (trailing-5-day average volume vs trailing-63-day average volume). Only stocks with vol_ratio > 1.5 (50% above their own recent-quarter average volume) are eligible breakout candidates; among eligible candidates, rank by pct_to_high descending. Q1 = strongest confirmed breakout (BUY), Q5 = weakest confirmed breakout among the volume-confirmed subset (not a 'new low' -- see known limitation below).
known_limitation: Because ranking happens only within the volume-confirmed subset, Q5 here is not a mirror-image bearish signal (a stock making new LOWS on high volume) -- it is simply the weakest breakout among stocks that already cleared the volume filter. The long-short spread is therefore a weaker test than momentum's; the long-only Q1 leg is the primary test of this hypothesis.
universe: identical to momentum_preregistration.json: full Sharadar PIT eligible universe excl. Finance/Real Estate, same liquidity/history filters. A week with fewer than 25 volume-confirmed candidates is skipped (no rebalance that week).
factor_model: FF5 + UMD (6-factor). UMD is reported as a diagnostic (breakouts are related to but mechanistically distinct from momentum) but is NOT a pass/fail criterion the way it is for the momentum family -- volume confirmation is the distinguishing ingredient here, not a horizon choice within the momentum family.
falsification_criteria: PASSES if long-only Q1 alpha t>2.0 AND long-only Q1 small-cap alpha t>2.0 (the long-only leg is primary here per known_limitation above). SUGGESTIVE if long-only alpha positive but t<2.0, or long-short spread t between 1.5 and 2.0. FALSIFIED if long-only Q1 alpha is negative and significant, or long-only t<1.0 (no signal). COST_SENSITIVE if alpha survives but annualized cost estimate exceeds 3%/yr.
size_pattern_prediction: small > mid > large (breakout signal strongest in less-covered, less-analyst-followed names where a resistance break carries more new information)
